semiconductor_relevance: High — SignOff Semiconductors provides specialized design services within the semiconductor industry.
summary: SignOff Semiconductors is a consulting firm that offers a range of design services to semiconductor companies, leveraging a team with extensive industry experience. Founded in 2015, the company focuses on delivering high-quality design solutions, including physical design, RTL design, and verification services, to help clients meet aggressive project timelines.
capabilities: Full Custom Analog and Digital Custom Layout and Verification

regional_presence.India: SignOff Semiconductors has offices in Bengaluru and Hyderabad to cater to local clients.
regional_presence.Canada: The company maintains an office in Toronto to serve North American customers.
regional_presence.United States: SignOff has a presence in California to support its U.S. client base.
